name: George Wright (Boston oak-maple woods in autumn)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). George Wright Golf Course, Hyde Park, from the developer's photos (release assorted-lidar-data, george.1-6) and NAIP, drawn in October: fairways and greens still bright green; an olive rough with a golden cast of the long native grasses (F0-F2) beyond a mown band; the woods' floor russet leaf litter (G0-G2: woods and out-of-bounds woods); bright white sand; dark, still ponds; grey Roxbury puddingstone in the paths' greys. Trees in assets-src/trees_george_wright.py: red and sugar maples, birch, red oak, white pine and hemlock turning: about half still green. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
